findings.evidence: with pytest.raises(AssertionError) catches any assertion error during _assert_uv_version_parity(modified) without verifying the specific error message via match=.
findings.title: pytest.raises lacks match pattern

findings.evidence: The negative test only exercises top-level workflow env drift on continuous-delivery.yml, leaving the job-level and step-level override assertion branches without negative test coverage.
findings.title: Missing negative test coverage for job- and step-level overrides

findings.evidence: workflow.get('env', {}).get('UV_VERSION') (as well as job and step env checks) will raise AttributeError if env is explicitly defined as null in YAML rather than raising AssertionError.
findings.title: Chained dict .get calls assume env mapping is not None
